WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    CustomerId,
    SUM(Total) as customer_total
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY CustomerId
),
overall_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_sum
  FROM customer_totals
),
paired_with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ct.CustomerId,
    ct.customer_total,
    ct.customer_total / os.total_sum as share
  FROM customer_totals ct
  CROSS JOIN overall_sum os
  WHERE os.total_sum IS NOT NULL
),
average_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM paired_with_shares
),
kept_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    p.CustomerId,
    p.customer_total,
    p.share
  FROM paired_with_shares p
  CROSS JOIN average_share_val a
  WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
    AND p.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(customer_total) as avg_customer_total,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_val)) as avg_share_minus_avg_share
FROM kept_rows
